value.rationale: The theorem completes the density-occurrence spectrum for the natural family of generalized-metallic Beatty arrays and isolates the nontrivial phase distinction between a universally covered golden-ratio array and positive-density uncovered integers at c>=2. The exact generalized Lucas witness classification is upgraded to positive-measure families, and zero/one levels have explicit lower bounds; this is a structural classification, not a finite test.
